veranderings.voor: kos, klere, musiek, diens en besoek
veranderings.na: kos, klere, musiek, dienste en besoeke
veranderings.rede: The singular 'diens en besoek' reads stiff in a list of things you see at a festival; the plural countable nouns read naturally.

veranderings.na: Die Islamitiese kalender volg die maan
veranderings.rede: 'Die Islamitiese kalender' is the established Afrikaans name; the hyphenated compound reads like a translation.
'Soet kos' is vague and wooden; 'soet geregte' says the same thing more naturally.
'Daar' repeats 'na die tempel toe' in the same sentence and adds nothing.

veranderings.voor: met opset nie te eet nie
veranderings.rede: 'Met opset' carries a sense of deliberate wrongdoing in Afrikaans; 'doelbewus' is neutral and clearer for a definition.
'Gedurende' is the natural preposition for a period of time like a month of fasting.

vlae.teks: Die maand waarin Moslems van dagbreek tot sononder vas.
vlae.rede: Read on its own the glossary entry says all Muslims fast, while the study text says 'Die meeste volwasse Moslems' and exempts young children, sick people and travellers; the qualifier is a content decision, so it is flagged rather than changed.
